DECLARE @EMAILLIST VARCHAR(250)
DECLARE @EMAIL VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @R INT
DECLARE @TMP1 TABLE(EMAIL VARCHAR(100))

INSERT INTO @TMP1 
 SELECT CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MARKET_CONTACTS_EMAIL 
 FROM PDS_CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MARKET_CONTACTS
 WHERE CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MARKET_CONTACTS_MARKET = @item.name

SET @EMAILLIST = ''

SELECT @R = COUNT(*) FROM @TMP1

WHILE @R > 0
BEGIN
 SELECT TOP 1 @EMAIL = EMAIL FROM @TMP1
 SET @EMAILLIST = @EMAILLIST + CASE WHEN @EMAILLIST='' THEN '' ELSE ';' END + @EMAIL
 DELETE FROM @TMP1 WHERE EMAIL = @EMAIL
 SELECT @R = COUNT(*) FROM @TMP1
END

SELECT @EMAILLIST AS EMAILLIST

SELECT COUNT(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER) AS NONCALLLISTJOBCOUNT 
FROM PDS_CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING DSS 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST CL ON DSS.CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD = CL.CALLLIST_CD 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
		(PDS_CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE CCR 
			INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE CR ON CCR.CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = CR.CALLLISTRULE_IID) 
		ON (CL.CALLLIST_IID = CCR.CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE_CALLLIST_IID AND CR.CALLLISTRULE_CD = 'DELDAILYSCRUB') 
WHERE CCR.CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE_CALLLISTRULE_IID IS NULL AND DSS.CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MARKET = @item.name

DECLARE @EMAIL_NME VARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @R_NME INT
DECLARE @TMP1_NME TABLE(EMAIL_NME VARCHAR(1000))

SET @EMAILLIST_NME = ''

WHILE @R_NME > 0
BEGIN
 SELECT TOP 1 @EMAIL_NME = EMAIL_NME FROM @TMP1_NME
 SET @EMAILLIST_NME = @EMAILLIST_NME + CASE WHEN @EMAILLIST_NME='' THEN '' ELSE ';' END + @EMAIL_NME
 DELETE FROM @TMP1_NME WHERE EMAIL_NME = @EMAIL_NME
 SELECT @R_NME = COUNT(*) FROM @TMP1_NME
END
